segments.name: Contract logistics
segments.description: Operates contract logistics warehouses worldwide, providing distribution, fulfillment, e-commerce and reverse logistics services to large corporations that outsource their supply chains.
segments.evidence: The Company presents its operations in the Consolidated Financial Statements as one reportable segment.

revenueModel.text: Customers, largely large corporations that outsource warehousing and distribution, pay the company for technology-enabled contract logistics services such as warehousing, order fulfillment, e-commerce and reverse logistics.
revenueModel.evidence: We provide our customers with high-value-added warehousing and distribution, order fulfillment, e-commerce, reverse logistics and other supply chain services.

changes.text: In 2025 the company met held-for-sale criteria for the anticipated Wincanton Divestment of certain U.K. grocery contracts, expected to complete in 2026.
changes.evidence: On June 19, 2025, the CMA approved the Wincanton Acquisition, subject to the divestment of certain grocery contracts in the U.K.
